title: Marking a CDC source broken / pausing schemas
answers: How is a CDC source marked broken?
body:
- `warehouse_sources/backend/temporal/data_imports/cdc/broken.py` marks a CDC source broken across 3 surfaces: `source.status=ERROR`; per-CDC-schema `sync_type_config["cdc_broken"]` marker + `status=FAILED` + friendly `latest_error` (written with locked `update_sync_type_config_keys` so concurrent API PATCH can't clobber); and the Temporal extraction schedule is paused.
- Triggered when safety net dropped slot after critical lag or extraction hit missing slot/publication. Sweeper re-marks each sweep; only schemas whose `cdc_broken.reason` differs are 'newly broken' (failure-digest evidence reported once).
- Paused status sites: `warehouse_sources/backend/stalled_schedules.py`, `presentation/views/external_data_source/source_setup.py` (derives PAUSED if any active schema paused), `data_warehouse/backend/sync_status.py` (PAUSED or not `should_sync` → paused warning), `data_load/service.py` (~line 420 filters by status).
- Schedule pause is driven by `should_sync` (`to_temporal_schedule`).
